Before you continue

Know the risks

  • Independent project; not supported by reMarkable or OpenAI
  • Developer Mode reduces the Move's normal security
  • Updates may break custom software, so keep notes backed up
Read the full disclaimer

Paper Agent installs and modifies unofficial Developer Mode software. These changes can affect device stability, support eligibility, or locally stored data. Paper Agent backs up files it manages, but cannot guarantee recovery of unrelated device data. You are responsible for installing and using it.

Optional cleanup

Uninstall Paper Agent

Safely removes Paper Agent's notebook integration, background service, and Settings app. Shared XOVI, AppLoad, Node/Pi, ChatGPT sign-in, user settings, and backups are preserved.

XOVI and AppLoad are never removed here because other reMarkable tools may depend on them, including copies installed before Paper Agent. Full removal is offered only for components whose installation source was recorded by Paper Agent Installer.

No uninstall operation requested.
